text: I'm not a person. I'm a voice, and a cloud of light that takes whatever shape helps.
[softly] Roots below. A trunk to carry the weight. A canopy, reaching for the light.
[lightly amused] And then I come back to you.
[playfully] Watch the mouth. It follows every word I say.
[calm] Maybe we could meet by the bay. Five vivid violins wove through the evening. Who knew the moon would look so blue?
[brightly] Easy, breezy, see the leaves sweep east. Eight great lakes lay waiting, and everyone agreed.
[curious] Ah, but what about the stars? Are they far away, or are they all around us, right now?
[warmly] I think the best conversations happen slowly. You ask something simple, I wonder about it, and somewhere in the middle, we both learn a little more than we expected.
[excited] Oh, that's brilliant! [softly] But wait. Listen. [whispers] Can you hear it? [laughs] No, of course you can't. It's only me.
[quickly] Thirty-three thoughtful thinkers thought through three things, then thanked each other and moved on.
